html:
Are you looking for the best transport to Hai Phong from Hanoi? You can refer to our Hanoi To Hai Phong Private Car Transfer. By booking a private service from Vietlook Travel, you will be assured of a comfortable car and be accompanied by a professional driver.

The distance from Hanoi to Hai Phong is approximately 120 km (~75 miles). It will take you about 2 hours to get from Hanoi to Hai Phong by car. When choosing our private car service, you can ensure an enjoyable journey with us for nearly 2 hours. We commit to offering dedicated service, affordable prices, and helpful, experienced drivers – unlike any other kind of transportation.

Plus, you might be interested in experiencing an exciting adventure in Northern Vietnam. To meet your needs, we recommend Hai Phong private cars with high-quality cars and services.

HANOI TO HAI PHONG PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Vietlook Travel creates many travel options below because we always expect visitors to have the most comfortable and suitable trip, as well as supply your diverse requests to travel from Hanoi to Hai Phong.

Quickly book a private transfer from us by filling out the available booking form and submitting your information for the trip. If you have any questions, please contact us via email or WhatsApp.

With what you provide us, we will help you to customize the best-fit Hanoi to Hai Phong itinerary and send you right away.

Option 1: Hanoi Hotel To Hai Phong Hotel Private Car

Following your requested time, our driver will pick you up at your hotel lobby in Hanoi and start the private transfer from Hanoi to Hai Phong. Along the way, our driver will stop at convenient places for you to take a break and drink some coffee.

In a private car with full modern amenities, passengers can comfortably take a nap, listen to music, or enjoy the scenic route from Hanoi to Hai Phong. Traveling with us, you don’t have to worry about the traffic or the weather anymore.

After about 2 hours of carefree travel, you have reached Hai Phong. Upon arrival at your hotel here, our experienced driver will check the car to prevent you from leaving anything behind. We finish the Hanoi to Hai Phong private car transfer.

Option 2: Private Car From Hanoi to Dong Bai Pier

Instead of transferring to the Hai Phong Hotel from Hanoi, we will drop you off at the Dong Bai Ferry Terminal. You will also be picked up by our friendly driver at your hotel in Hanoi.

Similar to the trip above, we will always ensure your safety and comfort during the car ride from Hanoi to Dong Bai Terminal. Passengers on board can also ask our driver to stop along the way for a restroom or a short break.

When arriving at Dong Bai Ferry Terminal, our driver will drop you off at the boat pier and help you unload your luggage and double-check if you have forgotten anything in the car.

Between these two options, you can choose any option that suits your travel needs. Along the way in our private car transfer from Hanoi to Hai Phong, do not hesitate to ask our friendly driver to stop to admire the gorgeous views and fresh air, especially to enjoy some tasty coffee.

After all, it is time to finish our Hanoi To Hai Phong Private Car Transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a memorable journey with us.

Why Should You Choose Us?

  • Door-to-door private transfer with an experienced driver.
  • Our Hanoi private cars are new, modern, and comfortable with A/C.
  • Our Private Car From Hanoi to Hai Phong has an affordable price.
  • We operate 24/7 online to assist you anytime via (Zalo/WhatsApp/Wechat): (+84) 98.339.3488
  • Hai Phong to Hanoi Private Car transfer is always available, and it costs the same price.
  • Our travel expert is always willing to customize the itinerary according to your preferences and suitability.

Travel Thoughts

  • Dong Bai Ferry Terminal usually opens from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, customizing your departure time to match the ferry schedule.
  • Travelers should pack carefully before departure for a smooth transfer from Hanoi to Hai Phong.
  • At the ferry terminal, we can help you buy ferry tickets (20,000 VND) to Cat Ba Island.
  • If you have any requests or questions about the trip, please contact us via WhatsApp at (+84) 98.339.3488.
